name: Laureate
line: Nobel gravitas in alternating black and ivory: a medal drawn in thin gold line, a laurel wreath around the four IARC groups, draws itself in leaf by leaf on load, and the two explorers sit in gold-framed plaques whose double hairlines draw themselves as they appear.
notes: The medal is SVG drawn for the page; its legend reads only 'How sure the evidence is' and 'EpiDetective' so it cannot be mistaken for an IARC seal. Gold is used for lines and for text on black only; on ivory, small text uses #5F5B54 and on black #A6A196 so the grey passes AA. On phones a small HTML legend of the four groups appears under the medal because the engraved inscription becomes too small. Libre Caslon Display is Latin-only (Libre Franklin covers Cyrillic). The plaque frames use @property for the draw-in; browsers without it simply show the frames.
